idea-plugin.name: IDE Pilot
idea-plugin.description:
Lets AI agents see and drive the IDE over MCP, the way the Playwright MCP drives a browser. For plugin development and UI testing in the runIde sandbox.

Tools

  • pilot_action – runs an IDE action by ID.
  • pilot_click – clicks the component or row with a ref: left, middle or right button, double-click, with modifier keys.
  • pilot_evaluate – runs a Groovy script inside the IDE.
  • pilot_log – the idea.log tail, the IDE's caught exceptions, recent UI freezes, notifications, stdout/stderr, or Run/Debug console text.
  • pilot_open – opens a project, or a file at a line.
  • pilot_screenshot – PNG of a component, or of the active window with its popups.
  • pilot_snapshot – the visible UI as a text tree of windows, components and list and tree rows, with role, name, state and a ref to act on; paged, optionally with screen positions.
  • pilot_type – types text and presses keys; shortcuts run their actions.
  • pilot_window – brings a window to the front, resizes it, or closes it.
  • pilot_wait_for – waits for text to show or go, for indexing or background tasks to finish, for Run console text, or for a time.

The server listens on localhost and needs a token: generate it in Settings | Tools | IDE Pilot and paste it into the agent's MCP settings.
